en: Vintage multi‑view postcard with ornate floral borders. The front shows three black‑and‑white photographs: a central square with a large domed church labeled "Belvárosi székesegyház" (downtown cathedral), a city street scene labeled "Király uteza" (Király Street), and a church or convent building labeled "Zárda." At the top left is the Hungarian greeting "Üdvözlet Pécsről" and at the top right a German banner "Gruss aus Fünfkirchen." The right side contains a handwritten message in brown ink. The reverse side reads "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA. LEVELEZŐ‑LAP." with address lines filled in German cursive, including an address in Vienna, and several postal cancellation marks.
